measures.id: Crawford Marion ADAMH Board Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) – Crawford Marion Board of Alcohol, Drug Addiction and Mental Health Services
measures.summary: Asks whether to renew a property tax of up to 1 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027, for the Crawford Marion Board of Alcohol, Drug Addiction and Mental Health Services to operate alcohol and drug addiction programs and mental health programs. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,128,178 a year, or $15 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 1-mill ADAMH levy is renewed for 5 years.

measures.id: Marion County Board of Developmental Disabilities Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) – Marion County Board of Developmental Disabilities
measures.summary: Asks whether Marion County may renew a property tax of up to 3 mills for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027. The money pays for programs and services of the Marion County Board of Developmental Disabilities and for acquiring, building, renovating, financing, maintaining and operating developmental disabilities facilities. The county auditor estimates it will collect $4,029,211 a year, or $67 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 3-mill developmental disabilities levy is renewed for 5 years.
